prompt_en: A layered costume photograph shows a model guided by the attached portrait, portrayed as an adult fictional spacecraft technician. Her short dark bob, airy separated bangs, gently rounded face and large dark eyes follow the visual cues of the reference. She wears a plainly visible costume: a retro space workwear one-piece jumpsuit in matte ivory woven fabric, with a compact upright collar, a central front zipper, rust-orange shoulder and chest panels, two utility chest pockets, a narrow webbing waist belt with a small metal buckle, reinforced knee patches, pale work gloves and ankle-high utility boots. Her one-piece jumpsuit stays continuous across the waist into both trouser legs. The central front zipper follows the front of that same ivory coverall from its upright collar toward the waist. The waist belt stays in the side loops; its small front buckle is open, leaving a central gap that directly reveals the uninterrupted ivory cloth and zipper through the waist into the trouser section. At the end of a maintenance shift she stands beside a waist-high service-door lever in an old orbital workshop, turning the lever through a small quarter turn with her right gloved hand. Her right elbow is softly bent and the lever is beside her right hip, clear of her torso; her left arm hangs relaxed and both boots rest on the grated floor. The turned lever sits in a diagonal position against its circular mounting plate. Behind her, ribbed wall panels and a partly open service hatch recede toward a round frosted observation window. Amber light from a caged work lamp grazes the zipper teeth and glove creases, while cool blue window light rims her bob and separates the matte cloth from a brushed-metal door. A full-length three-quarter front view keeps her face, the whole garment and the hand-to-lever contact readable, with the calm end-of-shift expression and tactile uniform as the visual center. Image 1 guides the face and bob; Image 2 fixes the scene. Refine only the open front buckle and the same boots' short ankle-high shafts, keeping the gloves, lever contact, broad panels, pose, lighting and surroundings as in Image 2.
